rules.statement: A decision on an incidental issue by a Court in the exercise of its ordinary civil jurisdiction is not conclusive on questions arising on other causes of action.
rules.supporting_quote: What Knight Bruce V.C. himself meant by an 'incidental issue' is clear from the fact that what he held in the case was that the finding of fact in a suit in Ecclesiastical Court for a grant of letters of administration, necessary to the decision and appearing on the face of the order, was not conclusive in proceedings between the same parties in a Court of Equity for distribution.
